name: omnifingerprint-admanager
description: Self-hosted fingerprint-browser profile manager and multi-platform ad automation workbench (React frontend + local Puppeteer PUP server + Node/MySQL cloud backend)

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name omnifingerprint-admanager
scripts.deploy:bt: npm run build && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/deploy-bt.ps1
scripts.deploy:full: npm run deploy && cd email-worker && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.launch:puppeteer: set LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG&& set QUIET_LOGS=false&& set AUTO_CLICK_VERIFY=true&& set PUPPETEER_PORT=9999&& set BORROWED_IDLE_MS=180000&& node server/puppeteer-api-server.js
scripts.launch:puppeteer:force: set LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG&& set QUIET_LOGS=false&& set AUTO_CLICK_VERIFY=true&& set AUTO_CLICK_VERIFY_FORCE=true&& set PUPPETEER_PORT=9999&& set BORROWED_IDLE_MS=180000&& node server/puppeteer-api-server.js
scripts.launch:playwright: set LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG&& set QUIET_LOGS=false&& set AUTO_CLICK_VERIFY=true&& set PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=9999&& node server/playwright-api-server.js
scripts.launch:playwright:force: set LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG&& set QUIET_LOGS=false&& set AUTO_CLICK_VERIFY=true&& set AUTO_CLICK_VERIFY_FORCE=true&& set PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=9999&& node server/playwright-api-server.js
